recipes.name: Avgolemono Greek lemon chicken soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
1/2 cup (100 g) long grain rice or orzo
steps: Bring the broth to a boil in a big pot and add the whole chicken breasts.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) inside. Lift out and shred.
Add the rice to the broth and simmer for 15 minutes, until tender.
Whisk the eggs and lemon juice in a bowl until frothy.
Very slowly whisk 2 cups of hot broth into the eggs, a ladle at a time. This warms the eggs so they don't scramble. Ask an adult to help.
Turn the heat to low and stir the egg mix back into the pot.
Stir for 3 to 4 minutes, until silky and slightly thick. Don't let it boil.
Add the chicken, salt and pepper and top with dill.

recipes.name: Fasolada Greek bean soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup (80 ml) olive oil, plus more to serve
3 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) cannellini or great northern beans, drained
5 cups (1.2 liters) vegetable broth or water
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth, bay leaf, oregano and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 35 to 40 minutes, until thick and the vegetables are very soft.
Mash a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken it.
Serve with parsley, a drizzle of olive oil and lemon.

recipes.name: Gazpacho cold tomato soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) ripe tomatoes, cored and chopped
1 red or green bell pepper, chopped
1 slice stale white bread, crust removed (optional)
1/3 cup (80 ml) extra virgin olive oil
2 tablespoons sherry or red wine vinegar
Diced cucumber, pepper and croutons to top
steps: Chop all the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Put the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion, garlic and bread in a blender.
Blend for 1 to 2 minutes, until very smooth.
With the blender running, pour in the oil, then the vinegar and salt.
Pour into a jar and chill for at least 2 hours, until very cold.
Stir, taste for salt, and serve cold topped with diced vegetables and croutons.

recipes.name: Jamaican red pea soup
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) red kidney beans, with their liquid
8 oz (225 g) smoked turkey or salted beef, chopped (optional)
1 whole scotch bonnet pepper (don't cut it)
1 lb (450 g) potatoes or yams, cubed
1 cup (125 g) flour, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/3 cup (80 ml) water, for spinners
steps: Chop the onion, garlic, green onions and potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Put the beans, meat, water and coconut milk in a big pot and bring to a boil.
Add the onion, garlic, green onions, thyme and whole scotch bonnet. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Mash some of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the soup.
Add the potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Mix the flour, salt and water into a stiff dough. Roll pieces between your palms into thin 2 inch logs called spinners.
Drop the spinners into the soup and simmer for 15 minutes more, until cooked through.
Take out the scotch bonnet and thyme stems carefully, add salt to taste, and serve.

recipes.name: West African peanut soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks
2 cups (60 g) chopped spinach or collards
Chopped peanuts and cilantro to serve
steps: Chop the onion, garlic, chicken and sweet potato. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth and sweet potato and bring to a boil.
Whisk the peanut butter with 1 cup of hot broth from the pot until smooth, then stir it back in.
Add the cayenne and salt and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the sweet potato is soft and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the greens for 2 minutes. Top with peanuts and cilantro.

recipes.name: Harira Moroccan soup
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) lamb or beef, cut in small cubes (optional)
1/2 cup (100 g) brown or green lentils, rinsed
1/2 cup (15 g) chopped cilantro and parsley
1/4 cup (30 g) broken vermicelli or rice
2 tablespoons flour mixed with 1/2 cup (120 ml) water
Lemon wedges and dates to serve
steps: Chop the meat, onion, celery and herbs. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and brown the meat for 5 minutes.
Add the onion, celery and spices and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, chickpeas, tomatoes, water and half the herbs and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 40 minutes, until the lentils and meat are tender.
Add the vermicelli and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Slowly stir in the flour and water mix and simmer for 5 minutes, until silky.
Stir in the rest of the herbs and serve with lemon and dates.

recipes.name: Sancocho
ingredients: 2 green plantains, peeled and cut in chunks
1 lb (450 g) yuca, peeled and cut in chunks (frozen works)
2 ears of corn, cut in 3 pieces each
1 lb (450 g) potatoes, cut in chunks
Cooked white rice and avocado to serve
steps: Rub the chicken with lime juice. Wash your hands.
Chop the onion, pepper and garlic and peel and cut the plantains and yuca. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a very big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, pepper, garlic and half the cilantro for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, turning.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the plantains, yuca and corn and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes and simmer for 20 minutes more, until everything is tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the rest of the cilantro and serve with rice and avocado.

recipes.name: Ajiaco Colombian chicken potato soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) small yellow potatoes, peeled and sliced
1 lb (450 g) russet potatoes, peeled and sliced
1 lb (450 g) red potatoes, peeled and cut in chunks
3 ears of corn, cut in 3 pieces each
2 tablespoons dried guascas herb (optional, but traditional)
Heavy cream, capers and avocado to serve
steps: Simmer the chicken, broth, onion and garlic in a big pot for 30 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C). Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Peel and cut the potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Add all the potatoes and the corn to the broth and simmer for 30 minutes. The yellow and russet potatoes will melt and thicken the soup.
Stir in the guascas and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Take out the onion and add the chicken back in.
Serve with a drizzle of cream, a few capers and sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Caldo verde
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil, plus more to serve
2 lb (900 g) russet potatoes, peeled and cubed
7 cups (1.7 liters) water or chicken broth
8 oz (225 g) Portuguese chourico or Spanish chorizo, sliced
1 bunch collard greens or kale, sliced into very thin ribbons
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and potatoes, slice the sausage, and roll the greens up and slice them very thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, water and salt and simmer for 20 minutes, until very soft.
Mash or blend the soup until smooth.
Brown the sausage in a pan for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the greens to the soup and simmer for 5 minutes, until tender but still bright green.
Add the sausage and serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Borscht
ingredients: 8 cups (2 liters) beef or vegetable broth
Sour cream and fresh dill to serve
steps: Peel and grate the beets and carrot and chop the onion and potatoes. Ask an adult to help, and wear gloves because beets stain.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add the beets, tomato paste and vinegar and cook for 10 minutes, stirring.
Add the broth, potatoes and bay leaf and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the cabbage, garlic, salt and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes more, until the cabbage is tender.
Take out the bay leaf and serve with sour cream and dill.

recipes.name: Hungarian goulash soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) beef chuck, cut in 3/4 inch cubes
steps: Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onions for 8 minutes, until golden.
Add the beef and garlic and cook for 5 minutes, until browned on the outside.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the paprika and caraway. Paprika burns fast.
Add the tomato paste and broth and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour.
Add the carrots, pepper, potatoes and salt and simmer for 30 minutes more, until the beef and potatoes are tender.

recipes.name: Cabbage soup
ingredients: 1 small head green cabbage, chopped (about 8 cups / 600 g)
8 cups (2 liters) vegetable or chicken broth
steps: Chop the vegetables and cabbage. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the cabbage, tomatoes, broth, thyme, paprika, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes, until the cabbage is tender.
Stir in the lemon juice and taste for salt.

recipes.name: Chicken and rice soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
3/4 cup (140 g) long grain white rice
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the broth, chicken and thyme and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside. Lift it out and shred it.
Add the rice and simmer for 15 minutes, until tender.
Add the chicken, salt, pepper and parsley.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken gnocchi soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) half and half or milk
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, then stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth and half and half.
Add the chicken, salt and thyme and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the gnocchi and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until they float.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.

recipes.name: Taco soup
ingredients: 1 packet (1 oz / 28 g) ranch seasoning mix (optional)
2 cans (14.5 oz / 410 g each) diced tomatoes
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) pinto beans, drained
3 cups (720 ml) beef or chicken broth
Shredded cheese, sour cream, tortilla chips and avocado to serve
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef and onion in a big pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the taco and ranch seasonings.
Add the tomatoes, beans, corn and broth and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve topped with cheese, sour cream, chips and avocado.

recipes.name: Cheeseburger soup
steps: Chop the vegetables and potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef in a big pot over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain it and set it aside.
Melt the butter in the pot and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the broth and potatoes.
Simmer for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Add the milk and beef and heat for 5 minutes. Don't let it boil.
Take off the heat and stir in the cheese, ketchup, mustard and salt.

recipes.name: Lasagna soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef or Italian sausage
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the meat and onion in a big pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, seasoning and salt and bring to a boil.
Add the broken noodles and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until tender.
Mix the ricotta, mozzarella and parmesan in a bowl.
Ladle soup into bowls and top each with a big spoonful of the cheese mix.

recipes.name: Slow cooker vegetable beef soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) beef chuck, cut in 1 inch cubes
1 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste
steps: Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Season the beef with salt and pepper and brown it in the oil in a pan over medium-high heat for 5 minutes. This step is optional but adds flavor.
Put the beef, onion, carrots, celery, potatoes, tomatoes, broth, Worcestershire, thyme and bay leaves in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours, or on high for 4 to 5 hours, until the beef is tender.
Stir in the green beans and corn and cook for 20 minutes more.
Take out the bay leaves and add salt to taste.

recipes.name: Carrot ginger soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) carrots, peeled and sliced
4 cups (960 ml) vegetable or chicken broth
1/2 cup (120 ml) coconut milk or cream
steps: Chop the onion and slice the carrots. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the carrots, ginger and garlic and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the carrots are very soft.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in the coconut milk and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Roasted red pepper tomato soup
ingredients: 4 red bell peppers, cut in big pieces
1 lb (450 g) tomatoes, cut in half
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the peppers, onion and tomatoes.
Toss them with the garlic, oil and salt on a big sheet pan.
Roast for 30 minutes, until soft and charred at the edges.
Put everything in a pot with the paprika and broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the cream. Top with basil.

recipes.name: Creamy cauliflower soup
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut in florets
4 cups (960 ml) vegetable or chicken broth
1/2 cup (50 g) grated cheddar or parmesan (optional)
steps: Chop the onion, garlic, cauliflower and potato. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the cauliflower, potato, broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes, until very soft.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in the milk, cheese and nutmeg and heat through.

recipes.name: Matzo ball soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) vegetable oil or schmaltz
1/4 cup (60 ml) seltzer water or chicken broth
steps: Whisk the eggs, oil and seltzer. Stir in the matzo meal and salt.
Cover and chill for 30 minutes, until firm.
Slice the carrots and celery. Ask an adult to help.
Bring a big pot of salted water to a boil.
With wet hands, gently roll the mix into 1 inch balls. Don't pack them tight.
Drop them into the boiling water, cover, and simmer for 30 to 35 minutes, until puffed and cooked through. Don't lift the lid early.
Meanwhile, simmer the broth, carrots and celery for 15 minutes and add the chicken.
Lift the matzo balls into the soup with a slotted spoon and top with dill.

recipes.name: Tuscan white bean soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried rosemary or 1 sprig fresh
3 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) cannellini beans, drained
6 cups (1.4 liters) vegetable or chicken broth
steps: Chop the vegetables and kale. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and rosemary for 1 minute.
Add the beans, broth and parmesan rind and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend about a third of the soup to make it creamy.
Stir in the kale and salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Take out the rind and add the lemon juice.

recipes.name: Tomato egg drop soup
ingredients: 4 cups (960 ml) chicken broth or water
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
steps: Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the tomatoes for 3 to 4 minutes, until soft and juicy.
Add the broth, sugar, salt and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 minute.
Turn the heat to low and slowly drizzle in the eggs while stirring.
Add the sesame oil and green onion.

recipes.name: Pork sinigang
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) pork ribs or pork belly, cut in chunks
1 packet (1.4 oz / 40 g) sinigang tamarind soup mix
2 cups (250 g) green beans, cut in 2 inch pieces
2 cups (60 g) water spinach or regular spinach
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Put the pork and water in a big pot and bring to a boil. Skim off the foam.
Add the onion, tomatoes and fish sauce and simmer for 1 hour, until the pork is tender.
Stir in the tamarind mix.
Add the radish and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the green beans, eggplant and chilies and simmer for 5 minutes more.
Add the spinach for 1 minute. Taste and add more fish sauce if needed. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken tinola
ingredients: 2 inch piece ginger, cut in thin strips
1 green papaya or 2 chayote, peeled and cut in wedges
2 cups (60 g) spinach or malunggay leaves
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and ginger and cut the papaya. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, turning.
Add the fish sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Add the water and bring to a boil. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the papaya and simmer for 10 minutes, until tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the spinach for 1 minute and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Taiwanese beef noodle soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) beef shank or chuck, cut in 2 inch chunks
steps: Boil the beef in water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse. This keeps the soup clear.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the garlic, ginger and green onions for 2 minutes.
Add the chili bean paste and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add the beef, star anise, cinnamon, soy sauce, sugar and water and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 2 hours, until the beef is very tender.
Boil the noodles as the package says, adding the bok choy for the last 1 minute. Drain.
Put noodles and bok choy in bowls and ladle the beef and broth over them. Ask an adult to help with the hot broth.
Top with pickled greens and cilantro.

recipes.name: Curry laksa
ingredients: 1/3 cup (85 g) laksa paste, or red curry paste
12 oz (340 g) boneless chicken thighs, thinly sliced
8 oz (225 g) thick rice noodles or egg noodles
Cilantro, mint, lime wedges and fried tofu puffs (optional)
steps: Slice the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and fry the laksa paste for 2 minutes, stirring, until fragrant.
Add the broth, coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar and bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the shrimp and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, until pink and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Cook the noodles as the package says and divide between bowls with the bean sprouts.
Ladle the soup over and top with eggs, herbs and lime.

recipes.name: Callaloo soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) callaloo, dasheen leaves or spinach, chopped
2 cups (280 g) pumpkin or butternut squash, cubed
2 cups (480 ml) vegetable broth or water
1 whole scotch bonnet pepper (don't cut it)
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, garlic, green onions and thyme for 4 minutes.
Add the greens, okra, pumpkin, coconut milk, broth and whole scotch bonnet.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 25 minutes, until everything is very soft.
Carefully take out the scotch bonnet and thyme stems.
Blend or swizzle until smooth, add salt and serve.

recipes.name: Scotch broth
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) lamb neck or shoulder, cut in chunks
1/2 cup (100 g) dried split peas, rinsed
1 cup (140 g) diced rutabaga (swede) or turnip
steps: Put the lamb and water in a big pot, bring to a boil and skim off the foam.
Add the barley and split peas and simmer for 1 hour.
Dice the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Add the vegetables, salt and pepper and simmer for 45 minutes more, until the lamb and barley are tender.
Lift out the lamb, pull the meat off any bones, chop it and put it back.
Top with parsley.

recipes.name: Stracciatella Roman egg soup
steps: Bring the broth to a simmer in a pot.
Whisk the eggs, parmesan, semolina, nutmeg and salt in a bowl.
Add the spinach to the broth for 1 minute.
Slowly pour the egg mix into the simmering broth while stirring gently with a fork.
Cook for 1 minute, until the egg sets into little rags.
Serve right away with more parmesan.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken wild rice soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream or half and half
steps: Simmer the wild rice in 3 cups of water for 45 to 50 minutes, until it splits open. Drain.
Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots, celery and mushrooms for 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the broth.
Add the whole chicken breasts and thyme and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C). Lift it out and shred it.
Add the chicken, wild rice, salt and cream and heat for 5 minutes. Don't let it boil.

recipes.name: Tomato rasam
steps: Chop the tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Crush the peppercorns, cumin and garlic into a rough paste with a mortar and pestle.
Simmer the tomatoes, tamarind, water, turmeric, salt and half the pepper paste in a pot for 10 minutes.
Add the rest of the paste and simmer for 3 minutes. When it gets frothy, turn off the heat. Don't let it boil hard.
Heat the ghee in a small pan and add the mustard seeds. When they pop, add the curry leaves and asafoetida for 10 seconds.
Pour this over the rasam and add cilantro. Sip it like soup or pour it over rice.
